title: The public card-plan offer surface changed across 2024 and 2025 without establishing consumer exposure
source_unit: CFPB Terms of Credit Card Plans product rows and reported issuer fields

denominator.unit: TCCP product rows after metadata/header rows

cashback_rewards.unit: rows whose Rewards text includes cashback

purchase_apr_median_percent.unit: percent; median of numeric product purchase-APR median fields

annual_fee_median_dollars.unit: US dollars among 121 numeric annual-fee rows

observations.method: TCCP spreadsheet header-row and product-row audit; descriptive counts and medians with no account or volume weights.
observations.uncertainty: Product rows are not cardholders, approvals, transactions, or market shares; field definitions and participation may differ across periods.
observations.subgroup: Product offers and named institutions in the 2024 H2 file.
observations.counterinterpretation: The reported product surface can change through participation, naming, reporting, or survey-field changes rather than consumer market change.

denominator.unit: TCCP product rows after metadata/header rows

cashback_rewards.unit: rows whose Rewards text includes cashback

purchase_apr_median_percent.unit: percent; median of numeric product purchase-APR median fields

annual_fee_median_dollars.unit: US dollars among 113 numeric annual-fee rows

observations.method: TCCP spreadsheet header-row and product-row audit; descriptive counts and medians with no account or volume weights.
observations.uncertainty: Product rows are not cardholders, approvals, transactions, or market shares; field definitions and participation may differ across periods.
observations.subgroup: Product offers and named institutions in the 2025 H2 file.

observations.period: 2024 H2 to 2025 H2; descriptive product-surface comparison

denominator.unit: TCCP reporting-period files compared; product rows are not linked longitudinally

product_row_change.unit: percent change in reported product rows, 566 to 663

named_institution_change.unit: percent change in named institutions, 145 to 195

credit_tier_apr_variation_change.unit: additional product rows marked Yes, 346 to 396

annual_fee_median_change.unit: US dollars, $95 to $95 among numeric rows

observations.method: Cross-file descriptive comparison produced by scripts/analyze_cfpb_tccp_terms_trend.py; no claim that rows represent the same products or that changes are consumer-weighted.
observations.uncertainty: The two files differ slightly in column count and product/institution participation. Product-level median APRs are not borrower-weighted realized rates and do not establish cheaper credit.
observations.subgroup: Reported product offers across the two TCCP periods; credit-tier and field-specific subgroups retain their own universes.
observations.counterinterpretation: Offer-surface changes may reflect survey redesign, issuer participation, product entry/exit, naming, eligibility, or missingness rather than changes in access or cost for consumers.

boundary: This is a two-file product-offer comparison. It does not establish a linked product panel, consumer exposure, approval, realized APR, fees paid, rewards received, market growth, or household financial outcome.
